method.chest: Torso perimeter 5 mm below horizontal arm-to-torso section merge.
method.bustProxy: Largest sagittal section depth above waist+60 mm and below chest-20 mm. Geometric proxy, not a nipple landmark.
method.waist: Minimum exact torso section perimeter in 60-70 percent of total height.
method.hip: Torso section at maximal posterior extent in 48-58 percent of total height.
method.neck: Minimum exact section perimeter in 84.5-86.2 percent of total height.
method.shoulder: Highest mesh vertex on each side with abs(x) between 0.16 and 0.23 m and z<0.08 m.
method.axilla: Binary search of the transition between three horizontal arm+torso loops and a merged loop.
method.perimeter: Triangle-plane intersections joined at 0.1 micrometre coordinate tolerance. Sum of closed polygon segment lengths. Arms excluded by selecting the central loop.

landmarks.sides: left and right refer to negative and positive x in the asset, not a clinical laterality convention

provenance.sourceHeader: # MakeHuman CC0 base mesh; processed browser collision/render asset. Units: metres.
provenance.source: User Library processed MakeHuman OBJ asset
provenance.licenseVerification: Official MakeHuman LICENSE.md sections C and D identify base mesh and output as CC0. Original OBJ header declares this asset a MakeHuman CC0 base mesh.
provenance.upstreamDerivationLimitation: The processed OBJ contains no upstream revision or transformation history. Its exact derivation cannot be independently reproduced from this file.
provenance.transform: No pose, scale, axis, or origin change. Coordinates rounded to 0.1 micrometre. Original triangle indices retained.
provenance.limitation: Reference avatar, not a scan or a reconstruction of the user's body. Landmarks are geometric estimates, not anatomical measurements.
